Issues with a Specific GP
​There is significant dissatisfaction with a particular, overconfident GP who is seen as a leaping frog. This GP is consistently available but is considered incompetent in fulfilling patient requirements and is very rude. He often takes phone consultations before appointments and claims to be 'free most of the time,' asking patients to arrive earlier than their scheduled time. Their primary goal is not to improve patient health but to prolong illnesses in order to exploit the patient. Furthermore, these practitioners are pathologically denying their wrongdoings, negligence, and gross misconduct.
